stageMeta.title: Shell / Process Execution: real side effects
headerComment: # Stage 04 — Shell / Process Execution: real side effects
# L4 = L3 + Shell.  Every plugin from Stage 03 is still here — FS tools,
# persistence, resume — plus the Shell capability seam:
#   dsh-bash-local         Provider: implements ctx.shell (runs real bash commands)
#   dsh-tool-fs-search     Consumer: glob / grep tool schemas (depends on ctx.subprocess)
# The Agent can now read/write/edit files AND run commands — edit, test,
# git, anything.  This is where "Q&A" becomes "coding agent": the model
# has real side effects.  Up to L3 the model could only operate on files;
# now it can start real programs and see stdout/stderr/exit codes.
# The persona is frozen from this stage onward (L4 → L5 → L6) so that the
# L4→L5 A/B experiment is truly single-variable: only the safety layer
stageMeta.driverQuestion: Read src/calculator.js, find the divide-by-zero bug, fix it by adding a guard for b === 0 that throws an Error, then run: node -e "const c = require(\'./src/calculator\'); try { c.divide(1,0) } catch(e) { console.log(e.message) }" to verify.
